rewrites.//: The website proxies /workout-tracker/* here with the prefix stripped, so paths normally arrive bare. This maps the prefixed form back onto real files so the *.vercel.app URL also works standalone — useful for previews, where there is no proxy in front.
SPA fallback. Vercel checks the filesystem before applying rewrites, so this only catches routes with no matching file — never an asset.

headers.//: Content-hashed filenames, so they can never go stale.
The shell must revalidate, or a deploy ships new assets that nothing references.
